label: Apple Mail on macOS and iOS
proves: The document opts out of the reformatting and text inflation WebKit mail clients apply by default, declares a responsive viewport, and exposes accessible structure to VoiceOver.

expectations.because: Without a viewport meta tag, iOS Mail renders at a desktop width and zooms out.
Apple Mail reflows and rescales messages unless the message opts out explicitly.
WebKit inflates text in narrow columns unless text-size-adjust is fixed on the body.
Apple Mail composes the message over its own background, and an unset body colour shows through in dark mode.
VoiceOver announces the document title when a message is opened in its own window.
VoiceOver rotor navigation depends on heading elements rather than styled paragraphs.
WebKit reflows the layout while images load unless the intrinsic box is known.
A link that opens a new window must not expose the opener to the destination.
Apple Mail falls back to a legacy encoding when the message declares none, corrupting non-ASCII preview text.

limitations.detail: Apple Mail inverts light colour schemes in dark mode unless the message declares a supported colour scheme. No scenario declares one.
limitations.degrades_to: Dark-mode appearance in Apple Mail is unproven and may invert brand colours.

limitations.detail: Apple Mail auto-links dates, addresses, and phone numbers, restyling that text. The compliance address is a likely target.
limitations.degrades_to: The postal address may render as a blue link in Apple Mail.
